title: 3.1.0 White Theme Problems
symptom: When using Light Theme on a Pixel 5 App crashes and can't be restarted. Keeps on crashing and AAPS doesn't open again. Same behavior reported on OnePlus 3 and OnePlus 8 Pro.
cause: The crash is caused by an InflateException in the overview_fragment layout when switching to light theme, as shown in the logcat.
fix: The issue was solved with pull request #1926, which likely fixed the layout inflation error.
